entries.title: F6 goes on from the panel you click after switching back
entries.body: When you had clicked into a card and a new card arrived while you were in another app, clicking into a panel after switching back could leave the window treating the card as where you were, so F6 took you to the wrong place. The window now follows your click.
entries.noPicture: The fix is which part of the window the keyboard's own keys count from, which a still picture cannot show.
